description: This is a Java test source file containing integrated HTTP CORS compliance tests for an Eclipse Hono HTTP adapter component, focusing on preflight OPTIONS requests and checking correct CORS headers in responses.

classes.name: CorsIT
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class that verifies CORS headers and behavior of the HTTP adapter component in the Eclipse Hono project.

methods.description: Initializes the static HTTP client for tests.
